    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckRegistration" name="Check car registration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Registered" name="Car still registered?" default="Flow_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyOwner" name="Notify owner of service due"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Timer_30Days" name="30 days passed">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_30Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_WentToService" name="Car brought to service?" default="Flow_NotWentToService"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueFine" name="Issue fine"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Serviced" name="Service visit recorded"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Fined" name="Owner fined"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRegistered" name="No reminder sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckRegistration" sourceRef="Start_ServiceDone" targetRef="Task_CheckRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegistrationCheck" sourceRef="Task_CheckRegistration" targetRef="Gateway_Registered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Registered" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="Task_NotifyOwner">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${registered == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotRegistered" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Registered" targetRef="End_NotRegistered"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Notified" sourceRef="Task_NotifyOwner" targetRef="Timer_30Days"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DeadlineReached" sourceRef="Timer_30Days" targetRef="Gateway_WentToService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WentToService" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_WentToService" targetRef="End_Serviced">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${carBroughtToService == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotWentToService" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_WentToService" targetRef="Task_IssueFine"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fined" sourceRef="Task_IssueFine" targetRef="End_Fined"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Car Service Facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CarDelivered" name="Car delivered for service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_CarDelivered" messageRef="Message_CarDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordProblems" name="Mechanic enters car problems for reference"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Repair" name="Repair car"/>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="Boundary_StatusInterval" name="Status update interval" attachedToRef="Task_Repair" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TED_StatusInterval">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/P1D</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendStatus" name="Send status update email"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StatusSent" name="Status update sent"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" name="Mechanic enters that repair was successful"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterPickerl" name="Mechanic enters that Pickerl was issued"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AfterPickerl" name="Repair recorded"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Payment" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Payment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Paid" name="Payment received"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterNextService" name="Mechanic enters time for next service"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendNextService" name="Send successful service and next service date to app"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ServiceCompleted" name="Service completed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Received" sourceRef="Start_CarDelivered" targetRef="Task_RecordProblems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartRepair" sourceRef="Task_RecordProblems" targetRef="Task_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusTimer" sourceRef="Boundary_StatusInterval" targetRef="Task_SendStatus"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusSent" sourceRef="Task_SendStatus" targetRef="End_StatusSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairDone" sourceRef="Task_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RepairSuccessEntered" sourceRef="Task_EnterRepairSuccess" targetRef="Task_EnterPickerl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PickerlEntered" sourceRef="Task_EnterPickerl" targetRef="Gateway_AfterPickerl"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AwaitPayment" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterPickerl" targetRef="Catch_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Paid" sourceRef="Catch_Payment" targetRef="End_Paid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterNext" sourceRef="Gateway_AfterPickerl" targetRef="Task_EnterNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendNext" sourceRef="Task_EnterNextService" targetRef="Task_SendNextService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Completed" sourceRef="Task_SendNextService" targetRef="End_ServiceCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>

</bpmn:definitions>
